warning: Supplier routes and published prices are research, not selections, full quotes or confirmed 2027 availability.

sections.title: Venue, ceremony and cocktail rooms
sections.budget_scope: Single venue-driven envelope: shop toward $30,000; hard ceiling $32,139; financial fits requires $31,139 or less. All room, food/bar, staff, rental, cake, ready-room, parking and required-fee costs share that envelope.

vendors.name: Old Hickory Golf Club
vendors.published_price: Wedding package, minimums and required wedding fees unknown. The $119.50 figure in older analysis is a solver ceiling, not a price.
vendors.scope: Club ballroom; advertised furniture, standard linens, tableware, dance floor, service personnel, cake cutting, changing rooms and coordinator. In-house wedding food/bar proposal is the intended route.
vendors.gaps: 185 rounds with dance floor; heated indoor ceremony/holding plan; separate cocktails; full access/flip/strike; outside-vendor and candle permissions; end time; coordinator scope; parking charges; 2027 all-in price and dates.
vendors.budget_status: Unknown; prioritize requested-interest quote, not a confirmed budget fit.

vendors.name: The Villa — Grand Ballroom / Catering by Uptown
vendors.published_price: Wedding package and date-dependent food/beverage minimum unknown.
vendors.scope: Package route with mandatory in-house food and alcohol; outside cake permitted. Grand Ballroom advertised for 125–250 and indoor weather backup offered. Additional floral/decor installation and removal require a licensed professional unless an exception is confirmed.
vendors.gaps: 185 rounds plus dance floor, heated ceremony and separate cocktail allocation, precise included rentals/rooms, access/strike hours, paid rehearsal, candle/outside-DJ rules, parking charges and complete 2027 quote.
vendors.budget_status: Unknown; compare a complete package, not a bare room price.

vendors.name: Oak Room at Sandy Spring Volunteer Fire Department
vendors.published_price: Saturday rental $3,000 for 8 hours; outside caterer $500; contracted extra hours $200/hour. Current 2027 proposal unknown; model applies 4% to dated costs.
vendors.scope: Hall route: published 220 seated with dance floor, tables/chairs, kitchen, breakout room and free parking. Venue approves licensed/insured caterer and qualified bartender; renter supplies table setup/strike labor.
vendors.gaps: Rounds layout, heated ceremony or priced flip with 185-person holding room, breakout/cocktail capacity, getting-ready solution, all access hours and complete catering/rental/cleanup proposal.
vendors.budget_status: Unknown; published rental does not establish complete wedding cost or required room flow.

vendors.name: The Gathering Place — Patuxent Grand Ballroom
vendors.published_price: Rent and required room fees unpublished; getting-ready suite has an additional charge.
vendors.scope: Hall route: ballroom advertised up to 265 seated with dance floor, movable partitions, venue table/chair setup and licensed outside catering permitted. Preferred list includes MISSION BBQ.
vendors.gaps: Approved 185-person rounds/dance layout, heated ceremony/holding and separate cocktail sequence, actual table sizes, rental/partition/ready-room prices, cleanup/strike duties, permits, parking and full 2027 quote.
vendors.budget_status: Unknown; zero-rent models are incomplete subtotals.

vendors.name: Crowne Plaza College Park — Grand Ballroom + Annapolis room
vendors.published_price: Wedding package unknown. Current hotel amenities page publishes $15/day parking; event waiver/2027 event charge unknown.
vendors.scope: Hotel package route: fact sheet lists Grand Ballroom banquet capacity 320 and Annapolis reception capacity 250. Onsite hotel rooms can simplify the overnight plan if separately quoted.
vendors.gaps: 185 rounds plus dance floor, heated ceremony/holding allocation, furniture/service package, actual access hours, outside vendors/candles and 2027 total. Old fact-sheet free-parking claim conflicts with current hotel parking tariff; written event terms required.
vendors.budget_status: Unknown; do not credit free event parking pending written confirmation.

vendors.gaps: Actual room category, date-specific tax-inclusive total within $600 overnight allowance, incidental hold, parking, cancellations, venue drive time, early/day-use/prior-night access and permission for preparation team.

sections.title: Food, catering staff and required charges
sections.budget_scope: Within complete venue-driven shopping target $30,000 / hard cap $32,139, together with venue, hosted bar, cake, rentals and tax. Outside caterers require venue approval. No complete quote establishes budget fit.

vendors.gaps: Local-store applicability; 185 guests; cocktail-hour food; dietary needs; staff count/hours; delivery; tax/gratuity; china/glasses/flatware and guest linens; room setup/flip, bussing/strike; hosted bar and coffee not established.
vendors.budget_status: Promising component pricing; complete venue and food-service fit requires quote. No all-in price inferred.

vendors.name: IndAroma
vendors.published_price: Typical $14,000 event for about 250 guests; Saturday/peak minimums higher. Not a $56/person rate and not a 185-guest quote.
vendors.scope: Buffet/family-style service, kitchen and waitstaff, rentals/equipment, and professional bar service can be itemized together; client usually supplies alcohol.
vendors.gaps: Saturday minimum; 185-person menu; exact rentals and labor; fees/gratuity/tax/travel; alcohol and bar supplies; venue approval. Taking 2027 weddings is not date availability.
vendors.budget_status: Strong integrated-service inquiry; complete price and budget fit unknown.

FAQ adds 20% gratuity or specified fixed amount, travel and applicable food tax. Beverage options $3/person each; bar setup $4/person with client alcohol.

vendors.gaps: 2027 tariff and complete wedding service; cocktail food; extended hours; rentals and china; bartenders; ice/glassware; travel; cleanup. Confirm included gratuity once and avoid duplicate assumed charges.
vendors.budget_status: Partial dated menu, not full quote. Escalate dated components 4% annually only for planning; full fit unproven.

vendors.gaps: 185-person upgrade/capacity; full hours; travel/tax; glassware; venue approval. Package and FAQ conflict on ice/mixers, requiring written reconciliation. Coffee/tea not established.

vendors.price_year: unknown; products and local store pricing depend on selection

sections.title: Wedding cake, tasting, delivery and cutting
sections.budget_scope: Current model allowances within venue envelope: cake $1,480 + tasting/delivery $150 + cutting $370. Published components do not replace these allowances until complete quotes arrive.

vendors.name: Heidelberg Pastry Shoppe — traditional wedding cake
vendors.published_price: $5.50/serving base; tasting $20; delivery from $40. 185 base servings $1,017.50; cake+tasting+minimum delivery $1,077.50 raw / $1,212.04 after 4% annual escalation to 2027.
vendors.scope: Traditional buttercream wedding cake with base flavors/fillings. Raw and escalated totals are partial estimates only.
vendors.gaps: 2027 quote; design, premium flavors/fillings, actual delivery mileage/time, tax, stand, top-tier retention and cake cutting/service. Detailed dated sheet takes precedence over older conflicting introductory price.
vendors.budget_status: Promising within $1,630 cake/tasting/delivery baseline before unresolved costs; no saving secured. Cutting separately retained.

vendors.name: Classic Bakery — traditional wedding cake
vendors.published_price: From $7/serving at 75+ servings and three tiers; delivery from $100. Tasting $60 credited toward order. 185 base servings + minimum delivery = $1,395 before tax/upgrades/actual travel/cutting.
vendors.scope: Traditional cake with base filling, icing and decoration; delivery priced separately.
vendors.gaps: 2027 tariff and design; delivery mileage; tax; cutting/service; optional stand rental and refundable deposit if needed. Avoid counting credited tasting twice.
vendors.budget_status: Published partial floor suggests possible baseline fit; undated tariff and full quote remain unknown.

vendors.name: Heidelberg Pastry Shoppe — optional small cutting cake and sheets

vendors.scope: Optional presentation change with small display/cutting cake and sheet portions. Sheet cakes are not layered; differs from traditional wedding cake.
vendors.gaps: Old price sheet; baker-approved wedding portions, design, actual 2027 price, tasting, delivery, tax and cutting/service. Couple must choose this presentation before implementation.
vendors.budget_status: Illustrative saving opportunity only, not a quote or approved design substitution. Keep allowances intact.

vendors.budget_status: Must fit $400 or be offset within the approved plan after complete quote; no reserve use.

Welcome/place cards do not establish a seating chart/table numbers.
